name: Knowledge Is Power
oracle_text: Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn.

needs.what: the static magnitude leaf {"cards_drawn_this_turn": "you"} in static_value_keys, so a `buff` static's power and toughness can be the number of cards its controller has drawn this turn, recomputed continuously as cards are drawn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cards_drawn_this_turn exists only in value_keys (effect amounts); static_value_keys has spells_cast_this_turn, creatures_died_this_turn and permanents_entered_this_turn but no draw tally, and a leaf outside static_value_keys is a load error. A pump trigger on `draw` would miss creatures entering later and would not be an anthem
